verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State is a state government business-filing and public-records agency, not a cloud or SaaS data host. A user choosing a storage region or data residency is a category error for a state registry whose filings are public records held by the state. Nothing in the evidence shows any user-selectable storage location that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
